explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/260 in the affirmative: for any strictly increasing integer sequence with a_n/n → ∞, the sum Σ a_n/2^{a_n} is irrational. It is stated via HasSum, which is not vacuous since such series converge. Allowing finitely many non-positive terms (a : ℕ → ℤ) adds only rationals. The solved status rests on Wang's preprint (arXiv 2606.24972) and the linked formal proof; my cached copy of the page lists only Erdős's partial results.
